sources.prompt: Production character model sheet (turnaround) for a Korean 2D side-scrolling action MMORPG, hand-painted anime game art style: clean confident dark outlines, cel shading with soft gradients, high-resolution illustration, crisp readable silhouettes. Plain flat light gray background. The SAME character drawn five times in one horizontal row at identical scale, all feet standing on the same ground line, evenly spaced, full body from head to toe, nothing cropped: (1) front view, (2) three-quarter front view, (3) side profile facing right, (4) back view, (5) front view of the same character's base body wearing only the fitted black inner suit, the bandages and the boots (no coat, no armor plates, no weapon). Neutral A-pose standing, arms relaxed slightly away from the body, hands empty, calm stern expression. Character: lean athletic young adult male swordsman, about 7.5 heads tall; messy spiky silver-white hair with one crimson streak at the front left; sharp dark gray eyes; long black leather coat reaching below the knees, high stand-up collar and notched lapels, deep crimson lining visible on the collar, lapels, front opening and inner hem; coat sleeves end at mid forearm; black fitted turtleneck inner shirt; two black leather straps with silver buckles across the chest and a black belt with a silver buckle; both hands and forearms wrapped in crimson cloth bandages up to the elbow, fingers exposed; black trousers tucked into black boots with dark steel knee guards and shin greaves; a katana in a black lacquered scabbard with a silver end cap worn on the left hip in views 1 to 4, black hilt with crimson diamond wrap and a round dark iron guard. Identical design, colors and proportions across all five figures. No text, no labels, no watermark, no extra characters.
sources.review: MASTER. Closest to V6; bandages and chest straps consistent in all views. Errata listed in master_errata.
